tools.name: Antigravity
tools.description: Advanced agentic development platform with paired-programming agents, terminal sandboxes, multi-agent collaboration, and artifact canvas rendering.

tools.name: Cursor
tools.description: The most widely adopted AI-native editor. A fork of VS Code with instant codebase indexing, multi-file edits (Composer), and inline terminal error fixing.

tools.name: Google Jules
tools.description: Asynchronous GitHub agent that clones repositories in cloud sandboxes, navigates issues, runs test suites, and opens verified pull requests autonomously.

tools.name: Kiro
tools.description: Next-generation agentic IDE featuring real-time collaborative agents and multi-file intent parsing.

tools.name: PearAI
tools.description: Open-source alternative to Cursor built on VS Code with transparent model routing and customizable backends.

tools.name: Trae
tools.description: Adaptive AI-powered IDE by ByteDance featuring Claude 3.5 Sonnet / GPT-4o integration, workspace-wide context indexing, and agentic code transformation.

tools.name: Volt
tools.description: Open-source (MIT) agentic IDE built on the VS Code core that drives Claude Code and Codex agent CLIs over ACP and supports local LLMs via Ollama, with hunk-level review of agent edits and Git checkpoints.

tools.name: Windsurf
tools.description: Next-generation agentic IDE by Codeium featuring "Flows" that track real-time developer context and synchronized multi-step edits.

tools.name: Zed
tools.description: Lightning-fast, GPU-accelerated code editor written in Rust with deep model integration and multi-model assistant panels.

tools.name: Codeium
tools.description: Free AI code completion and chat extension for 40+ IDEs with low latency and enterprise self-hosting options.

tools.name: Continue.dev
tools.description: The leading open-source extension for VS Code and JetBrains; connects to cloud models or local models (Ollama, LM Studio).

tools.name: Supermaven
tools.description: Fast inline code completion engine featuring Babble architecture (acquired by Cursor in late 2024).

tools.name: Tabby
tools.description: Self-hosted AI coding assistant server; an open-source, private alternative to GitHub Copilot.

tools.name: Aider
tools.description: Command-line AI pair programmer that parses your repository into a Tree-sitter map, edits multiple files, runs lint/test commands, and automatically commits atomic git diffs.

tools.name: Avante.nvim
tools.description: Neovim plugin designed to emulate Cursor AI's multi-file editing capabilities natively in Lua.

tools.name: Claude Code
tools.description: High-agency agentic command-line tool capable of autonomous directory indexing, running bash commands, handling git diffs, and orchestrating complex multi-file refactors.

tools.name: Cline
tools.description: Autonomous coding agent extension for VS Code that executes terminal commands, inspects local browser previews, and requests human-in-the-loop permission.

tools.name: Codex CLI
tools.description: Command-line interface for OpenAI's coding models optimized for fast in-terminal code modifications and script execution.

tools.name: Flisk
tools.description: Agent-first local environment generator and CLI that automatically configures Docker Compose, Tilt, and Traefik stacks from an empty directory so coding agents can focus on application code.

tools.name: Gemini CLI
tools.description: Google's command-line agent utilizing 1M+ token context windows to ingest entire repositories for refactoring and debugging.

tools.name: Goose
tools.description: Open-source, extensible AI agent by Block that automates engineering tasks, script execution, and multi-tool workflows directly from the terminal.

tools.name: Kilo Code
tools.description: Open-source terminal-based developer coding assistant engineered for low latency workflows.

tools.name: Mentat
tools.description: Open-source AI tool capable of coordinating complex git workflows directly in the terminal with repo-wide context.

tools.name: OpenCode
tools.description: Provider-agnostic open-source terminal coding agent harness supporting custom agent loops, local model routing, and unified diff execution.

tools.name: Roo Code (formerly Roo Cline)
tools.description: Community-driven autonomous coding assistant extension for VS Code featuring custom agent modes and MCP server connectivity.

tools.name: Xenon
tools.description: CLI coding agent that records every session event in an append-only hash chain verifiable on demand via `/evidence`, enforces deterministic hollow-answer checks, and exports manual verification checklists with multi-model and MCP client support.

tools.name: AgentsMesh
tools.description: Platform for scheduling and isolating multiple coding agents across distributed workstations.

tools.name: Carbon Forge
tools.description: Hosted source control (a web service reached over MCP, no local model involved) where each coding agent works in a lane, a set of patches over the trunk, instead of a git worktree. A patch that no longer applies is reported as a named conflict rather than merged automatically, and git history is rendered from the record and pushed to GitHub.

tools.name: ccmanager
tools.description: Session manager for coordinating parallel CLI agent workflows across multiple repositories.

tools.name: Claude Squad
tools.description: Terminal manager for running multiple concurrent coding agent sessions across terminal tabs.

tools.name: cmux
tools.description: Ghostty-based macOS terminal designed with vertical workspaces and desktop notifications for agent fleets.

tools.name: MulmoTerminal
tools.description: Browser-based terminal grid running parallel coding agent sessions with dedicated git worktrees per cell, backed by tmux.

tools.name: Orkas
tools.description: Local-first desktop AI workforce coordinating specialist agents and external coding CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode) with custom model endpoints.

tools.name: Orca
tools.description: Autonomous development environment built to orchestrate and execute a fleet of parallel coding agents.

tools.name: Vibe Kanban
tools.description: Kanban board dashboard to plan, dispatch, monitor, and review tasks across multiple agent CLIs.

tools.name: BrowserTools MCP

tools.description: Provides agents with headful/headless browser interaction, console error capture, and network inspection capabilities.

tools.name: Context7 MCP
tools.category: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers for Coding
tools.description: Dynamic context-curation server providing real-time AST symbol definitions and semantic codebase navigation.

tools.name: Docsy
tools.category: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers for Coding

tools.name: Filesystem & Git MCP
tools.category: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers for Coding

tools.name: GitHub MCP Server
tools.category: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers for Coding

tools.name: Postgres MCP
tools.category: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers for Coding

tools.name: ReMCP
tools.category: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers for Coding

tools.name: Codestral
tools.description: Open-weight model specialized in code completion and fill-in-the-middle tasks with an 80-language vocabulary.

tools.name: DeepSeek-Coder-V2
tools.description: Mixture-of-Experts code language model with 128k context length supporting 338 programming languages.

tools.name: DeepSeek-V3 / DeepSeek-R1
tools.description: SOTA 671B Mixture-of-Experts (37B active) and reasoning foundation models matching top proprietary models in code generation, multi-file reasoning, and complex refactors.

tools.name: Devstral Small 2 (24B)
tools.description: High-efficiency 24B open coding model by Mistral featuring an ultra-long 384k token context window optimized for whole-repo reasoning and local 16GB VRAM execution.

tools.name: Llama-4 / CodeLlama Series
tools.description: Meta's open foundation architectures specialized for code generation, instruction following, and infilling tasks.

tools.name: Qwen2.5-Coder
tools.description: Leading open-source coding foundation model series (0.5B to 32B) competitive with leading closed models across code generation, completion, and multi-file reasoning.

tools.name: Qwen3-Coder Preview
tools.description: Next-generation reasoning and agentic foundation model pre-trained on extended multimodal code corpora with native tool-calling.

tools.name: StarCoder 2
tools.description: Open, transparently trained code models (3B, 7B, 15B) curated by BigCode under permissive licenses.

tools.name: llama.cpp
tools.description: High-performance C/C++ inference engine for quantized GGUF models with minimal hardware overhead.

tools.name: LM Studio
tools.description: Graphical desktop application for running local GGUF models on Apple Silicon and NVIDIA GPUs.

tools.name: Ollama
tools.description: The easiest way to get up and running with local models via a single terminal command (`ollama run qwen2.5-coder`).

tools.name: vLLM
tools.description: High-throughput, memory-efficient LLM serving engine featuring PagedAttention for production local deployments.

tools.name: agent-qa
tools.description: CLI and MCP agent for natural-language Web, Android and iOS testing, with persistent memory and validated self-improvement. Supports local models through OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

tools.name: CodeRabbit
tools.description: AI-driven pull request reviewer providing line-by-line feedback, sequence diagrams, and security vulnerability checks.

tools.name: Cover-Agent

tools.name: Keploy
tools.description: Open-source zero-code test generator that captures real network calls and creates automated regression test suites.

tools.name: Qodo (CodiumAI)
tools.description: Comprehensive code integrity platform analyzing PRs, writing regression tests, and enforcing code standards.

tools.name: Semgrep Assistant
tools.description: Combines deterministic static analysis (AST rules) with LLM explanations to eliminate false-positive security findings.

tools.name: Devika
tools.description: Experimental open-source software engineer agent capable of breaking down user goals into multi-stage tasks (historical reference).

tools.name: OpenHands (formerly OpenDevin)
tools.description: Autonomous software development agent capable of writing code, browsing the web, and running dockerized execution sandboxes.

tools.name: SWE-agent
